thread:
vanessa_b: Invoice INV-9133 (Acct: SAUDEBR-9) failed capture at 14:05 UTC. Attempt returned `authentication_required` and the bank page timed out. Customer is in BR and tried twice; says OTP page showed "Tempo esgotado" then disappeared. Can payments/help triage?

payments-bot: Automated event: payment.failed invoice=INV-9133 amount=1,980.75 provider=stripe decline_code=authentication_required

nathan_pay: Pulling logs: last_attempt id `ch_5Zx...` status failed. stripe.auth: "authentication_required". Card country BR, last4 7789. Issuer message: timed_out_on_challenge. Snippet:
```
provider: stripe
charge_id: ch_5Zx7789
status: failed
decline_code: authentication_required
auth_result: timed_out_on_challenge
last4: 7789
country: BR
```

leo_support: Customer ticket #13042. They asked if we can resend invoice link, or if they can pay via PIX (preferred locally). They also asked whether we can retry the card only once automatically.

vanessa_b: We should avoid auto-retries for 3DS failures — risk of multiple failed auths. Options: 1) Send a fresh hosted payment link for card (forces re-auth, expires 24h), 2) Offer PIX/boleto/wire. For PIX we need to check if finance can accept and reconcile (PIX is instantaneous). For international wire we need ops/legal because of cross-border compliance.

karen_ops: We can accept PIX for BR customers if treasury sets up a local payout receiving account. Currently we don't have a PIX rails configured. Wire (SWIFT) is available but slower and incurs fees. For this amount (~2k USD) PIX would be ideal but requires treasury enablement; that takes ~3-5 business days. I can approve a manual wire fallback now if legal signs the invoice acceptance.

legal: If customer signs the invoice acceptance we can approve wire reception. We'll need beneficiary name exactly matching bank account. I can prepare a short clause and send for e-sign.

nathan_pay: I'll create a Checkout session forcing re-auth. Example:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions \
  -u sk_live_xxx: \
  -d payment_method_types[]=card \
  -d mode=payment \
  -d line_items[0][price_data][currency]=usd \
  -d line_items[0][price_data][unit_amount]=198075 \
  -d payment_method_options[card][request_three_d_secure]=any \
  -d expires_at=`date -d "+24 hours" +%s` \
  -d success_url="https://app.redwood.example/pay/success" \
  -d cancel_url="https://app.redwood.example/pay/cancel"
```
I'll post the live link in a sec.

leo_support: Also need a short customer message explaining why the bank timed out and next steps (Portuguese ok). Keep it short and include PIX option note.

vanessa_b: Draft (PT-BR):```
Olá equipe SaudeBR,

Nossa tentativa de cobrar a fatura INV-9133 falhou porque o banco exige verificação 3D Secure e a verificação expirou antes de completar. Opções:
• Use este link seguro para tentar novamente e concluir a verificação do banco (expira em 24h).
• Pague via PIX — responda se quiser que enviemos instruções (pode levar 3-5 dias para configurar).
• Se preferir, podemos fornecer instruções de transferência internacional (SWIFT).

Se quiser transferência, confirme e enviaremos os dados bancários e uma cópia da fatura para conciliação.
Obrigado, Vanessa — Billing Ops
```

nathan_pay: Checkout created: https://pay.redwood.example/checkout/s/br-try-456 (expires in 24h). Metadata: invoice=INV-9133

leo_support: Sent the message + link to customer. Customer replied: "Trying link now, if fails we want PIX." :pray:

payments-bot: Automated event: payment.failed invoice=INV-9133 amount=1980.75 provider=stripe decline_code=timed_out_on_challenge

vanessa_b: Customer's link attempt also timed out (bank session flaky). They asked again for PIX now and said treasury can wait 3 days. Karen, can we fast-track PIX setup OR should we go wire?

karen_ops: Fast-track not possible same-day. For this invoice we'll do a manual SWIFT wire. Legal, please confirm clause so we can provide account details. I'll also flag treasury to watch for the incoming SWIFT reference.

legal: Sent invoice acceptance clause to customer for e-sign and cc contracts@redwood. Once signed, we can accept the SWIFT.

leo_support: Customer returned signed clause and initiated wire with ref PIX-FALLBACK-209. They also asked whether we can mark invoice as paid once funds land.

payments-bot: Note: manual wire received must be reconciled to invoice using the reference. Suggest tagging in QuickBooks with external ref PIX-FALLBACK-209.

vanessa_b: Great. Marking invoice INV-9133 as pending-wire and adding external_ref=PIX-FALLBACK-209. Closing this thread; we'll reconcile once treasury confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
